requirements.title: Sentinel-2 data acquisition
requirements.evidence: Real CDSE discovery/retrieval; experiments/final_demo live run
requirements.remaining_gap: No async/queued acquisition; single-provider-at-a-time per band group
requirements.safe_claim: Real Sentinel-2 scenes are discovered and retrieved through the Copernicus Data Space Ecosystem.

requirements.title: Multispectral preprocessing and harmonisation
requirements.evidence: 12-band harmonisation + RGBN adapter (Step F/G), exercised again in experiments/final_demo
requirements.remaining_gap: Non-RGBN bands are resampled/aligned only, never learned-SR'd
requirements.safe_claim: A real 12-band L2A product is harmonised onto one grid; only RGBN reaches the SR model.

requirements.title: Paired LR-HR dataset creation
requirements.evidence: frame.data roles/splits/leakage checks, real samples (SEN2NEON, OpenSR-Test, a SEN2NAIPv2 sample)
requirements.remaining_gap: SEN2VENuS format-only; full geography-checked SEN2NAIPv2 not done; MuS2 absent; no Indian data
requirements.safe_claim: Dataset roles, splits and leakage checks are implemented and tested on real samples; full-scale acquisition was not performed.

requirements.title: Super-resolution model
requirements.evidence: Real Lite/Mamba behind one registry; LDSR-S2 verified-but-undeployable (docs/REGISTRY.md)
requirements.remaining_gap: No 12-band/multi-resolution model; no ranking is or will be made
requirements.safe_claim: Two real RGBN x4 models are selectable, with a documented, verified compute-budget reason a third is not.

requirements.title: Spectral consistency
requirements.safe_claim: Spectral-consistency metrics are implemented and measured; they are not accuracy against ground truth.

requirements.title: Geospatial consistency
requirements.evidence: CRS/transform/bounds preserved and derived, COG-valid output, tile-seam diagnostic
requirements.remaining_gap: Co-registration of a reference image is a separate, measured problem (docs/RELIABILITY.md §3)
requirements.safe_claim: The output grid's CRS, transform, pixel size and bounds are correct and automatically verified.

requirements.title: Uncertainty / model-stability / error awareness
requirements.remaining_gap: Weakly associated with error, uncalibrated, texture-confounded (docs/RELIABILITY.md)
requirements.safe_claim: TTA stability is a reconstruction-variation diagnostic, not calibrated uncertainty.

requirements.title: SR accuracy and validation
requirements.evidence: frame.evaluate, real benchmark runs (SEN2NEON, OpenSR-Test), Step I engineering experiments
requirements.remaining_gap: No SEN2VENuS/full-SEN2NAIPv2 evaluation, no ESA baseline, no perceptual metrics
requirements.safe_claim: SR is measured against independent references with a registration gate; no ranking is made.

requirements.title: High-resolution reference validation
requirements.remaining_gap: No Indian HR reference exists or was substituted
requirements.safe_claim: No Indian high-resolution reference has been obtained; none is claimed.

requirements.title: Downstream analytical utility
requirements.evidence: frame.downstream NDVI/NDWI, real Indian self-consistency (Step H / Step I demo)
requirements.remaining_gap: No labelled task (land cover, crop, flood, burn-scar); India has self-consistency only, not downstream validation
requirements.safe_claim: NDVI/NDWI self-consistency is demonstrated; no task-level (e.g. land-cover) performance is claimed.

requirements.title: Operational / GIS-ready delivery
requirements.evidence: COG, STAC, product registry, tiling, a minimal background-job path, a real end-to-end demonstration (docs/OPERATIONAL_DELIVERY.md)
requirements.remaining_gap: No MapLibre tile-layer integration in the frontend; no TiTiler; no auth/containers/deployment
requirements.safe_claim: A real Sentinel-2 scene can be turned into a validated, downloadable COG with a real STAC item, over a real (demo-grade) API, end to end.

requirements.title: Geographic / Indian generalisation
requirements.evidence: frame.generalization (Step H): two real Indian-scene runs (Lite, Mamba), no HR reference
requirements.remaining_gap: One geographic point (Tamil Nadu/Chennai) is not India-wide generalisation; no urban/agriculture/coastal/forest/dry diversity was executed
requirements.safe_claim: A reproducible domain-shift protocol exists and was run once on a real Indian scene; this is not evidence of India-wide generalisation.
